text:
kevin: Heads up — CI / research team just opened an urgent request to reserve 20 A100s in us-west-2 for a short 72h burst. Queue says 36h lead time and billing shows a hold on their org. Can we short-circuit?

maria: whoa, 20 A100s for 72h is a big late-binding commit. What's the customer impact if we defer?

kevin: it's a paid pilot with a churn risk. They need runs to finish this week or they pull back. ops-oncall flagged the billing guardrail — looks like a budget cap triggered automatic hold.

infra-bot: Queue status for us-west-2 (A100 pool): pending_requests=9, requested_gpus=124, available_capacity=42, estimated_lead_time=36h. Active commits ramping in 6h.

ajay: Can we propose a smaller short-term reserved slice (e.g., 8 A100s) + transient spot for overflow? That buys time and reduces cost. Also need a grant to bypass org-level hold.

sophie: If we convert spot -> reserved for 8 immediately, we can allocate from the burst pool. But conversion needs billing approval. I can draft the override request.

kevin: @maria can you approve the SLA exception for the pilot (48h override)? Without it infra can't create the reserved instance.

maria: I can approve a 48h exception if we cap spend at $X and add automated teardown at expiry. Need documented justification in ticket.

kevin: will add justification. Also, quick question — will reverting to a different GPU SKU (e.g., H100s in us-west-1) reduce lead time?

infra-bot: us-west-1 H100 pool: pending_requests=3, available_capacity=60, est_lead_time=4h. Note: H100 cost per-hour ~25% higher for current OS image.

ajay: Cost calc: If 20xA100 for 72h @ $X/hr = $Y. 8 reserved + 12 spot (H100) for 72h = higher unit cost but much lower lead time and avoids billing override. I'll post numbers.

kevin: can we do a mixed strategy: 8 reserved A100s in us-west-2 (approved override), and route low-priority jobs to us-west-1 H100s until billing clears?

sophie: technically yes. We need two things: 1) short-lived reserved commitment for 8 A100s (create order) 2) routing policy change for team to allow region fallback. I'll prepare the infra change.

ops-oncall: note from oncall: if we approve override, set a hard cost cap + automated revert script. Last time a manual override slipped for a week and cost spiked.

kevin: agreed. I'll create a ticket with justification, cost cap, teardown time, and attach the customer's signed pilot PO.

maria: approved conditional on the teardown automation and PO. @sophie you have 2h to create the reservation order once the ticket is filed.

sophie: copying the command I'll use to create a short reserve (internal tool):

```
# reserve 8 A100s for 72h in us-west-2
infractl reserve --region us-west-2 --gpu a100 --count 8 --duration 72h --tags "pilot-sponsor:acme" --teardown-on 2024-12-02T04:00:00Z
```

sophie: and the routing patch, roughly:
```
# fallback policy
if region(us-west-2).lead_time > 12h then route(low_priority) -> us-west-1
```

kevin: I'll attach PO and submit billing override. Where do we escalate if finance denies? This needs exec attention.

maria: escalate to finance-ops Slack and cc product lead. But start with a 48h temporary override. If denied, we'll fall back to H100 plan.

ajay: FYI — converting spot to reserved in-place causes a billing reconciliation lag ~2 billing cycles. We should mark these resources with an internal chargeback tag so costs are reconciled to the pilot immediately.

kevin: good call. tagging: team=research, pilot=acme, chargeback=pilot-acme-2024Q4.

infra-bot: Reservation request queued: id=RQ-20241203-91, region=us-west-2, gpu=a100, count=8, duration=72h, status=pending-billing-override. ETA to provisioning after override=~30-45m.

ops-oncall: I'll watch the provisioning. If anything stalls >1h ping me. Also, add alert to kill the pool if teardown fails.

kevin: thanks everyone. I'll post the billing override ticket link when submitted.

maria: thanks — and please add a short retro after this so we can refine the late-binding commit playbook.
